Title: Sr Quantitative Representative - Pricing
Description: Job Description Why Quantitative Pricing at GM Financial? The Sr Quantitative Analyst - Pricing plays a key role in enhancing pricing strategies and processes through pricing model development and data driven business solutions. The Associate will focus on improving model integrity and accuracy through the collection, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of origination and forecast data. They will also apply advanced quantitative and analytical skills to improve decisions supporting various internal clients. This position will interact with many other departments to achieve overall company objectives. Responsibilities About the role ﻿Develop and maintain complex pricing models and perform profitability analysis for all of International Operations Monitoring and validating model performance and updating models as needed Developing and maintaining various databases, technical models, and reports required to support product and pricing proposals and analytic responsibilities Conducting ad hoc projects incorporating project design, data collection, model development, and analysis Summarizing findings and presenting results Developing recommendations for pricing policies and procedures Gathering and analyzing data to determine impact to company profitability and financials Providing direction, training, and guidance to less experienced pricing and finance personnel and leading projects or special assignments as required What makes you an ideal candidate? ﻿Strong quantitative, analytical and data mining skills Ability to identify and understand business issues and map these issues into quantitative questions Efficient modeling skills with very large datasets using SAS, SQL, Python, or R Proficiency in statistical experimental design or econometrics Ability to design and implement model documentation and monitoring protocols Demonstrated understanding and experience with technical systems, rational datasets, data warehouses, data mining, and data analysis techniques Advanced knowledge of principles, standards, practices, and techniques relating to profitability modeling for a financial firm Knowledge of applied statistical methodologies including multiple regression, logistic regression, sampling methodologies, time series, survival analysis, cluster analysis, categorical data analysis, decisions trees, multivariate methodologies, Bayes networks, non-parametric techniques, principal components, and linear programming techniques Effective written and verbal presentation skills with an ability to communicate well with Senior Management Organized, detail oriented, and ability to work independently with minimum instruction or supervision An ability to interact collaboratively with internal customers and external vendors Capable of managing multiple and varied projects including the ability to coordinate and balance numerous tasks in a time-sensitive environment, under pressure, and meeting deadlines Demonstrated quantitative skills and ability to apply complex financial and mathematical principles Advanced process and model documentation skills Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, R, and/or SAS software skills Good Word and Power Point skills Qualifications 2-4 years of related work experience or similar quantitative field Req And Greater than 5 years of modeling experience and strong coding skills Req Bachelor’s Degree

Title: Software Development Engineer II
Description: Job Description Why GSW? The Global Solutions Wholesale (GSW) application is the Backoffice platform used by the operations team to manage wholesale assets in Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. GSW has been designed to ensure that the wholesale business in all countries is able to increase the efficiency of country operations, by assisting in providing a better service to dealers whilst, at the same time, maintaining regulatory compliance. The GSW program team designs, delivers, and provides sustain capability solutions that enable and optimize Wholesale operations across Latin America. The team ensures that business processes are standardized, scalable, and compliant with local requirements while supporting market needs. By driving system integration, process efficiency, and data consistency, the program enables the organization to operate with greater agility and control. Responsibilities Being adaptable and knowledgeable in multiple domains enables team members to swarm or fill gaps to meet commitments. The SDE, under limited supervision, provides advanced systems support for a portfolio of applications within GMF’ Commercial Wholesale functional areas. This includes but is not limited to eliciting/documenting business functional/non-functional requirements, systems design, development or configuration, and development of automated testing activities. This role will work with internal / external product teams to ensure products are designed and developed in an iterative approach, quickly putting working software in the hands of our business teams while supporting and facilitating all aspects of the product development life cycle. The ideal candidate will be adept in influencing trade-off decisions for IT initiatives and demonstrate proficiency in Agile and/or SAFe delivery frameworks to help transform our business with incremental product delivery. Key Responsibilities The SDE II works under limited or no supervisory guidance and consistently delivers on commitments The SDE II is expected to demonstrate excellence in the software development practices performed by Scrum teams. Developing product features for any or all of the following: data marketplaces, mobile applications, web applications, and API services The SDE II invests in learning and experimentation to expedite cloud implementations Using automated pipelines for building, testing, and deploying software packages; continuously improving both the quality and speed of the pipelines Contributing to test automation and participating in peer reviews to increase product quality Maintaining a production-first mindset focused on scale, uptime, and ability to rapidly triage/resolve production issues Investing in our Agile practice to continuously improve product quality, time to market, and team member happiness Qualifications Skills & Qualifications: Software development expertise in the high-level programming language used by the product team AI and Agentic AI first approach throughout the SDLC Cloud Native experience Data and query analysis and optimization to deliver scalable, performant products and services Test driven development (TDD) practices to ensure code quality, reliability and maintanability. Proficient in new feature development, automated tests, and the implementation of security controls Experience working in Agile Scrum teams, suggesting and contributing to improvements (getting better/faster/happier) Demonstrates software development excellence (software is simple, understandable, reusable, and secure) Troubleshoots problems and works across teams to meet commitments Drives adoption of best practices; cultivates innovation and learning Strong attention to detail, with an expectation to deliver required outcomes according to quality, and timelines Excellent working relationship skills and strong customer focus The SDE will have expertise in the following technologies required for the product(s) being developed: Enterprise Service Bus: Tibco BusinessWorks (APIs and integration workflows) Pipeline Automation: Azure DevOps (YAML, ARM), Terraform, Jenkins, Chef, Octopus Deploy, Shell scripts AI: Github Agent, OpenAI, VisualStudio Co-pilot, prompt engineering IDE: Visual Studio/Code, IntelliJ Code Scanning: SonarQube, Checkmarx Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git). UI: Angular, Javascript, CSS, Node.js, ASP.NET MVC Containerization: Azure Kubernetes Service, Kubernetes (open source), Docker and WebLogic Experience in Java, .Net, DB query tools such as SQL Developer, TOAD or similar, COBOL is a plus, RESTful endpoints Experience using testing tools such as Cypress, Sikulix, Karate, Postman, or similar. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure). RHEL v8 or greater, or Unix Work Experience 2-4 years’ experience in software development required Education Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related Engineering field; and/or commensurate experience preferred Verbal and written proficiency in English, Portuguese and/ or Spanish. Title: Data Technology DMX SSA Data Engineer
Description: Your Team Responsibilities We’re a global, cross-functional team of data engineers and DevOps engineers led by a hands-on team lead. We build and operate the data platform and services that power analytics and mission-critical business use cases. We value pragmatic architecture, reliable delivery, and frequent PoCs to validate ideas quickly, leveraging modern tools—including AI—to accelerate development and innovation. We’re looking for a senior team member who can lead initiatives end-to-end—from clarifying requirements with stakeholders, to architecting solution components, implementing PoCs, and guiding production rollout. This role suits a broad generalist in the data domain with strong software engineering fundamentals and an architectural mindset. Your Key Responsibilities Build the future MSCI Analytics Data platform Collaborate with Product Management, Program Management and other internal stakeholders to convert business requirements into applications, tools, and deliver these as part of a product release roadmap. Collaborate with engineering teams across data and technology in implementing AI solutions and integrating services with MSCI’s data science products and platforms. Improve and create a modern and sophisticated platform using latest technologies and following industry best practices. Evaluate different Architectural & Design approaches, solutions, frameworks & technologies and recommend the most suitable one. Develop best practices for architecture, design, coding & automated test coverage. Architect, Design and develop secure, high performance, scalable and maintainable applications using appropriate architectural patterns. Ensure optimal availability, latency, scalability, and efficiency of real-time application development by advocating engineering reliability into the development life cycle with a focus on fault tolerant approaches. Our global operations team handles production support. This role is development-focused with no on-call responsibilities outside business hours. Contribute actively to the organization’s AI adoption by identifying use cases, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and leveraging AI-enabled tools to drive innovation, scalability, and competitive advantage. Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel Broad data technology knowledge (breadth over depth): Relational databases (e.g., Postgres/MySQL/SQL Server/Oracle) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB/Cassandra/DynamoDB). Data warehousing/lake patterns (e.g., Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, cloud data lake/lakehouse). Data formats & interchange (Parquet, JSON, Avro). 3+ years plus experience with one or more of the following languages: Python, Bash, Go (Go would be preferred) DevOps fluency: version control (Git), CI/CD, containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or equivalent), and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform). Highly organized and transparent: able to structure work clearly, maintain accurate documentation of designs, decisions, and processes, ensuring visibility for the team and stakeholders. Mentor and support junior colleagues: share your experience, provide guidance on best practices, and help grow the team’s technical capabilities. Knowledge of C++/Java/Scala is a plus. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
